description: Search Magist’s regulation corpus by keyword with optional filters (jurisdiction, domain, status, content-review status, coverage depth). Returns a paginated list of matching regulations with permanent citation URLs. Deterministic: the same query and filters return the same results every time. Returns research information for discovery, not a determination of which regulations apply to a specific product.

query.description: Free-text keywords. Optional; omit to browse with filters only.

name: search_regulations
title: Search regulations
